The other unchecked reads (gentransfertype 52, gensourceaccount 96, Gencustomeraccountid 41) cannot be NULL because of the SQL filters (ti.Gen_transferType in (1,7), ca.gen_sourceaccount is not null, PK), so the listed set is complete. results.detail: FT56: SDK Create gen_coursepartition x5 Result outputs are sync and feed Union All (90 in / 18 out) -> Derived Column -> Group by TransferIn (GroupBy transferinId, Sum interest, Min actualexecutiondate, Max arrearsdays_int; AggregationType 0/4/6/7) -> Update Transfer In (main.cs:54-57 gen_actualtransferdate = genactualexecutiondate). Rows reach Result regardless of Create success. FT56 Dates To Local inputs are only CreatedOn and gen_fundcreationdate (DTSX:45390). Close TI External runs later in the linear Success chain (Close TI internal -> Step 6 -> Close TI External). Its SQL (DTSX:14175) selects state 1, type 1/7 requests with CPs having non-null actual amount and date, min(cp.gen_actualtransferdate); Dates To Local (DTSX:13300) converts gen_actualtransferdate and gen_actualtransferdateDB; Update transferin main.cs:53-56 writes only if different from the DB value. Only writers of gen_transferin.gen_actualtransferdate in the package: Close TI External, Close TI internal (types 5/6 only), FT56 -> two sources for types 1/7 is correct.

Internal SQL (DTSX:24801): state 1, type 5/6, CP actual amount and date not null, HAVING ABS(DATEDIFF(day, min(cp.gen_actualtransferdate), ti.CreatedOn)) < 30 (direction-neutral, as stated). Is Between Course or Funds (DTSX:25024): 6 -> Union All 2 -> close columns with no further check; 5 -> need to update? (DTSX:25083) with EvaluationOrder 0 ISNULL(signature) -> not close, 1 ISNULL(receivedstamp) -> not close, 2 ISNULL(Expected) || ABS(actual-expected) <= expected*0.15 -> close, default not close. External SQL (DTSX:14175) same state/CP filters, no 30-day HAVING; split (DTSX:14395) !ISNULL(Gen_receivedstamp) && gen_actualtransferdate > Gen_receivedstamp. Label 'נתקבל' for the received-stamp date is supported by a code comment (DTSX:68551 'תאריך חותמת נתקבל').

Selection is by account CreatedOn relative to GETUTCDATE() (DTSX:11136), not by last run; Clone TransferIn is the first business step after Create ETL Process record (Success constraint), so any run that reaches it clones accounts in the window; 'כ-24 שעות' correctly approximates DATEDIFF(HOUR) semantics; schedule not in files. No other step creates clones.

Most units match DTSX:11136, Dates To Local (DTSX:10066, 9 dates, <2005 +2h) and Clone TransferIn main.cs:39-96 (5 identical copies). But unit [14] lists non-literal values as fixed values, unit [15] uses an unsourced label that contradicts [13] and finding#3, and units [1]/[2] state strict bounds that DATEDIFF does not implement.

wrongUnits.problem: 'נספח ד' שלה נשלח עד 6 חודשים לפני היום' is not what DATEDIFF(MONTH, ti.gen_appendixdsent, GETUTCDATE()) <= 6 does. DATEDIFF counts calendar-month boundaries, so an appendix sent up to almost 7 months earlier qualifies (e.g. sent on the 1st of January, run on 31 July -> 6). A future-dated value (negative difference) also qualifies.
wrongUnits.correct: Appendix D sent in a calendar month at most 6 month-boundaries before the current UTC month (up to almost 7 months), or in the future; NULL -> not selected.

wrongUnits.problem: 'נוצרו לפני 24 שעות לכל היותר' - DATEDIFF(HOUR, ca.CreatedOn, GETUTCDATE()) <= 24 counts hour boundaries, so accounts created up to almost 25 hours earlier qualify (minor).
wrongUnits.correct: Accounts whose CreatedOn is at most 24 hour boundaries before GETUTCDATE() (about 24-25 hours).

Group by TransferIn aggregates all selected rows of the request, so if another fund of the same request qualifies, the request is still updated (with totals of the qualifying funds only).
